conclusion: geom>baseline robust (+2.19pp, all 3 seeds). geom>random small but directionally consistent (+0.53pp, 2 strict + 1 tie). On this weak/heterogeneous teacher (geom_auc=0.66) most gain comes from reducing noisy KL; geometry's net add-on is small — consistent with L2 predictive law that geometric separability is lowest for weak teachers. Phase-2 should test whether geom-minus-random gain scales with teacher geom_auc (strongest test on Qwen32B, auc=0.88).
